title: DERIVED, not the source's own: SLSA Build Provenance v1 predicate (JSON rendering)
$comment: DERIVED by this library from the field tables and prose of build-provenance.md (source lines 245-553 of .cache/slsa-provenance-1-2.txt); the source ships no JSON Schema. Its own summaries are provenance.verbatim.cue and provenance.verbatim.proto, which say the TEXT is authoritative where they disagree (L116-117, L178-179). Root = the predicate (section 4.2). Reading rules fixed here: (1) L1 profile: a field the tables label REQUIRED is read as required at SLSA Build L1 (L250, L272, L407, L441, L511). (2) L110: unset, null and empty are equivalent, so an optional field accepts null and its empty value, and a REQUIRED field rejects null and its empty value, because an empty value is as good as absent. (3) L105: unrecognised fields are ignored, so no object here closes additionalProperties (extension fields, L540-553). OUTSIDE this source and NOT modelled: the in-toto Statement envelope beyond the four cue fields, the ResourceDescriptor required-ness rules (in-toto resource_descriptor.md), TypeURI and Timestamp as defined in in-toto field_types.md. Where this file chose a reading the text does not state it is listed in messages.yaml under source_defects and tested with basis 'inferred' or 'ambiguous' in schema-tests.derived.json.

Only the four fields the cue summary draws are modelled; their required-ness here is read from the cue summary (every cue field is drawn without an optional marker) and is OUTSIDE this source. subject must hold at least one item (the build outputs one or more artifacts, L96-97, R-0068); the items themselves are not constrained.

BuildDefinition.title: BuildDefinition (section 4.3, L268-402)

L110 makes an empty object equivalent to unset, which the REQUIRED label (L272) then forbids; minProperties 1 is that reading and is AMBIGUOUS. Completeness at SLSA Build L3 (L293-295) and the SHOULD to reject unrecognised members (L302-303) are not schema facts.

TypeURI.title: TypeURI (in-toto field type; section 4.3 L278, section 4.5 L447)
TypeURI.description: A string the text calls a URI. REQUIRED uses (buildType, builder.id), so null and empty are rejected (L110). Requiring a scheme is INFERRED from the word URI; RFC 3986 lets the part after the scheme be empty, so a scheme alone is accepted. in-toto's own definition is outside this source.

Timestamp.title: Timestamp (in-toto field type; cue comment L172)
Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 shape: date, T, time, optional fraction, Z or offset. The cue comment draws only the Z form with whole seconds (L172) while the proto type google.protobuf.Timestamp carries nanoseconds (L236-237); the wider reading is AMBIGUOUS and chosen here.

OptionalTimestamp.description: An optional Timestamp field: null or the empty string are equivalent to unset (L110).
